items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Oh, that was Mr. Shelton Brooks... I think he liked me because I sang his song... So Mr. Shelton Brooks said, 'That was good...'

ctx.x: I don't think -- let's just go back a little bit, Chuck, because I -- explain who was there -- because I don't think it's been recorded yet, who was there watching you dancing.

Oh, that was Mr. Shelton Brooks. He was the composer of 'Some of These Days,' 'Darktown Strutter's Ball' and some other songs, and I think he liked me because I sang his song, 'Darktown Strutter's Ball,' you see, and my aunt had taught me a little step to do, you know, like to go off. See, that was the last song I sang, and that's probably what put the idea into the audience's mind that I could dance.
